secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string. In the Base44 dev environment this is provided by the local compose Postgres service; set this only if pointing at an external/managed database.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret for signing Express sessions. A built-in dev default exists; set a real value for production.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending transactional emails (verification, notifications). Optional — email features are disabled without it.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY
secrets.description: NOWPayments API key for crypto deposits/payments. Optional — marketplace payments are disabled without it.

secrets.name: NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET
secrets.description: NOWPayments IPN signing secret for verifying payment webhooks. Optional.

secrets.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
secrets.description: Admin login email. Optional — admin login returns 503 until this and ADMIN_PASSWORD are set.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Admin login password. Optional — set together with ADMIN_EMAIL to enable admin access.
